about_the_game:
About the game:

Embark on this low-poly, space-themed FPS where your options are to either kill everyone (without failing) or escape (depending on the game mode).

Single-player mode: Choose a map and kill all the enemies. You have one bullet per enemy +1 extra. Headshots are lethal, but body shots require two bullets. Don’t miss.

Multiplayer mode: Invite your friends, choose a map, and set the escape mode in case things go wrong. Together you have just enough bullets to eliminate all enemies. The objective is to take the ship or escape in an escape pod. Find the key and decide what to do—together or separately. Good luck, let’s see who messes up first. And yes, friendly fire is on.

Enemies react to:

  • Gunshots

  • Noises from thrown objects

  • Discovering corpses along the way

  • You killing the teammate they were talking to

Multiplayer games require a minimum of 2 players and that you invite or are invited through Steam. There are no matches with strangers.

About development and notes:

This is a game made by a solo dev, using assets from Synty Studios. It’s been tested as much as possible, but you might still find bugs. If so, report them.

content_descriptors.notes: Headshots create a blood splatter effect that may not be suitable for all audiences.

short_description: Trapped on a ship full of aliens? Worse: trapped with your useless friends. One mag each, just enough bullets if no one misses. Good luck, you're screwed.
